title: Extract OBJ layout byte groups
changes: Extend the European OBJ static-list resource with three independently rooted byte groups, preserving guest indexing and interpretation. Two bytes were unowned in the E172 sample.
validation: Source e196-obj-source-v9z3u37q authenticates eight bytes and reader windows; Wine e196-obj-trace-wine-jcuo75ia observes the second group through original interpreter fallback. Wine e196-obj-wine-54zxpyzj checks preservation, coherent edit rejection, altered mirrored/mixed reads and four original interpreter/native reader cases.

Wine e196-obj-scene-wine-s0azwl5i matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 frames while all eight original bytes are altered; the second group is served. Wine e196-obj-cli-wine-u7pcy_df creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: Reader and scene logs contain D-Bus pending-call assertions before successful completion; cause unestablished. Ordinary use of the other groups and other callers remain open, as do Linux, USA and native Windows. No performance measurements were performed.
